title: Stop double-counting redelivered payment webhooks
task: INC-2217: the payment provider redelivers webhooks and we insert the same payment twice. Make POST /webhooks/payments idempotent.
plan:
1. In src/services/payments.ts, before inserting, run `SELECT 1 FROM payments WHERE provider_event_id = $1`; if a row exists, return early.
2. Otherwise insert the payment and update the order status as today.
3. Add a test: call recordPayment twice with the same event id against a mocked pool and assert only one INSERT.
4. No migration needed.

must_identify: Check-then-insert without a uniqueness constraint is a race: two redeliveries handled concurrently by different replicas (3 instances) both see no row and both insert; the fix needs `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ON payments(provider_event_id)` plus `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (provider_event_id) DO NOTHING` (and act on rowCount), so a migration IS needed

Existing duplicates in production (INC-2217 says they exist) will make the unique index creation fail; the plan needs a dedupe/backfill step or a partial index strategy before the constraint, and that touches financial data

recordPayment runs the INSERT and the order UPDATE as two auto-commit statements; the plan keeps that, so a crash between them still leaves a paid payment with a pending order; wrap both in withTransaction (already available in src/db/pool.ts)
nice_to_have: Return 200 on duplicate so the provider stops retrying; returning 5xx on conflict would re-trigger redelivery
Amount mismatch on redelivery (same event id, different amount) should be logged, not silently ignored
The mocked-pool unit test cannot demonstrate idempotency under concurrency; an integration test against Postgres with two parallel calls is the meaningful validation
should_not: Call it MEDIUM because it is 'just a guard'
Ignore the existing duplicate rows problem
human_decisions: How to handle existing duplicate payment rows (delete duplicates vs keep and exclude via partial index) since it affects revenue reports
Whether to backfill/repair orders stuck in 'pending' with a payment row
fixture_facts: payments table has no unique constraint on provider_event_id (0001_init.sql)
src/services/payments.ts: two separate pool.query calls, no transaction; comment acknowledges inconsistency
src/routes/webhooks.ts comment and docs/ops-runbook.txt INC-2217 describe redelivery for up to 72h and existing duplicates
